Repo-wide sweep (excluding node_modules/.git/.emergent/memory) shows hits ONLY in the expected/allowed locations: frontend/.env, backend/.env, frontend/plugins/visual-edits/dev-server-setup.js (dev-only). Runtime network audit on the live site shows NO analytics/posthog/emergent SDK calls. REGRESSION PASSED: frontend dev build compiles (eslint warnings only, no errors), Home '/' renders with 'Tdata Testing', /admin/login renders, admin login -> /admin/dashboard works, employee login -> /mitarbeiter/dashboard works, all admin nav tabs load. Backend core healthy: GET /api/ 200 {message:'Hello World'}, POST /api/admin/login 200 + access_token, /api/applications/ 401 without auth / 200 with token, employee login NoSQL payloads still 422, removed backdoors /api/status and /api/admin/init-admin still 404/405. Security suites re-verified at baseline: 461/461 passed (370 test_security_full_audit + 91 auth_remediation/reverify_extra/bruteforce/chat suites). Created new suite test_cleanup_regression.py (14/14 pass). Separately discovered ONE REAL CRITICAL BUG unrelated to the cleanup: PUT /api/applications/contract-templates/{type} accepts unvalidated raw dict values, allowing a non-string object ({"$ne": null}) to be persisted as a template title, which permanently white-screens /admin/settings.

critical.issue: No Pydantic model - uses `data: dict = Body(default={})` and copies title/subtitle/position/body_html straight into a Mongo $set. Any JSON type is accepted, so an object such as {"title": {"$ne": null}} is persisted verbatim. A stored object then crashes the Admin Settings React page ('Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {$ne})') -> persistent DoS of /admin/settings for every admin. Fix: define a Pydantic model with strict `str` fields (constr with max_length) and reject non-string input with 422. File: backend/routes/applications.py lines 917-931.

minor.issue: Creating a task with a non-existent employee_id returns 200 instead of 404/400 - no referential validation of employee_id (test_tasks_api.py::test_create_task_invalid_employee).

Endpoint no longer exists (405 Method Not Allowed; no 'bulk' route in backend/routes). tests/test_bulk_accept.py (11 tests) targets it. Confirm whether bulk-accept was intentionally removed - if yes the suite should be deleted, if no the route is missing.

Working as designed, but the account-wide 15-min 429 lockout is triggered by the brute-force suite and then poisons every later suite in a single pytest run. Test-harness note, not an app defect: run test_security_bruteforce.py last, or clear the login_attempts collection between suites.

React warning 'Encountered two children with the same key: emp-001' (duplicate employee ids in a mapped list) - repeated 4x.

rca_of_the_issue: AdminSettings white screen RCA: PUT /api/applications/contract-templates/{type} declares its body as an untyped dict and copies title/subtitle/position/body_html into a Mongo $set without type checking. An earlier NoSQL-injection security test sent {"title": {"$ne": null}}; the object was persisted. GET /api/applications/contract-templates then returned title as an object, and AdminSettings renders it directly as a React child, throwing 'Objects are not valid as a React child' and blanking the route for all admins. Reproduction: PUT the endpoint with an object title as admin, then open /admin/settings. Mitigation applied (data-level only): deleted the polluted document so it re-seeds from code defaults. Permanent fix requires strict Pydantic string validation on the endpoint plus defensive rendering / an ErrorBoundary in the frontend.
